scope: Independent read-only review of count/exclusion explanation changes

findings.evidence: daily_batch.py matched now uses in_scope then in_stage; old in_stage first checked chosen then the identical stage predicate. Status, warehouse and lock predicates unchanged. records order, all_matched, page clamp, 50-row slicing and observation attachment unchanged.

Explanations use the same active records before selected/stage/warehouse/lock/status filters. Every failed predicate adds its own reason; compound reasons preserved. Date/keyword exclusions are outside this input range and are not claimed as filter rejections.

Old-route operations explanation is added only after stage rejection in operations/all-stage mode and flow_version==1. Existing stage predicate determines absence/pending membership; it is not relaxed.

No new source of records added. lifecycle_home still derives from repository headers, active warehouse heads and archive visibility before explanation. The added list cannot introduce cache-only or deleted identities.

query clears and disables explanations immediately; failed does likewise. HistoryReader.request replaces callbacks by generation token; replies from older cancelled generations have no UI callback. ready re-enables only the newly completed explanation.

No additional SQL, source SKU reads, signed snapshot reads or history loads in explanation loop. Extra work is O(N) predicate checks over already loaded order metadata; stores six identity/status fields plus reasons for excluded orders. Clicking details creates O(excluded) display rows/cells. Incremental RSS not measured by this review.
No business-machine database was inspected; the concrete thirteenth order identity cannot be declared confirmed from screenshots or synthetic tests.
